CheckTitle: Check for EC2 Instances with a Public IP
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks whether EC2 instances have a public IPv4 address.
Risk: Instances with public IPs are directly reachable from the internet, so any security group mistake exposes them.

Recommendation.Text: Place instances in private subnets behind load balancers, NAT and SSM instead of assigning public IPs.

Notes: Not a numbered CIS AWS 3.0 control; mapped to 5.2 (network exposure of administration ports).
